sentences.text: Star Trek is an American science fiction media franchise based on the television series created by Gene Roddenberry .	Gene Roddenberry	Gene Roddenberry	Star Trek	Star Trek (film)	science fiction	science fiction	media franchise	media franchise	television series	television program

It followed the interstellar adventures of Captain James T. Kirk -LRB- William Shatner -RRB- and his crew aboard the starship USS Enterprise , a space exploration vessel , built by the interstellar federal republic United Federation of Planets in the twenty-third century . In creating Star Trek , Roddenberry was inspired by the Horatio Hornblower novels , the satirical book Gulliver 's Travels , and by works of western genre such as the television series Wagon Train .
